cohort: 40 pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to a tertiary care center in India between April 1 and June 30, 2021.
finding: The second wave of COVID-19 in India resulted in high morbidity and mortality among pregnant women, especially those over 30 years old with a higher BMI, with elevated inflammatory markers like CRP, D-dimers, and IL-6 associated with fatalities.
